programmes.d: Matt and Margaret investigate the kidnapping of banker Penrose from a stagecoach; they immediately suspect noted bandit Milt Sharp who recently escaped from a Nevada prison and his partner Dutch; a showdown takes place at the Penrose home.
Matt and Margaret investigate when a railroad payroll worth $25,000 is stolen.

Matt and Margaret head to Denver in the late 1860s after the killing of a railroad telegraph operator; bail jumper L H Musgrove, a known horse thief is their chief suspect; Musgrove and his pal end up facing vigilante justice.
Matt Clark and Frankie Adams pursue a female outlaw named Belle Starr after her gang steals a herd of horses from the U.S. cavalry.
Gambler Raoul de Moreney is accused of card cheating at the saloon; Harris Claibourne is challenged to a duel after discovering the cheater is a well-known hustler who has killed numerous men.
While arresting two gunmen at the saloon, Jake Hoyt saves Hollister from being shot in the back by a third gunman; Hoyt has an ulterior motive for saving Hollister's life.
An outlaw will surrender if his sweetheart gets the reward.
Lucas' old friend arrives for an unexpected visit.
An old enemy of Marshal Micah Torrance's arrives in town, bent on revenge.
A marshal from another territory comes to North Fork looking for a wanted man.
The owner of a casino in Paradise, Colo., refuses to pay the debts and taxes he owes, prompting Bat's appointment to the role of county tax assessor.
Bat faces a series of challenges as his crew builds a railroad in Colorado, including natural disasters, lost equipment and charges against Bat for a murder he didn't commit.
General George Armstrong Custer visits New Orleans and experiences an assassination attempt.
Yancey investigates the sinking of a record number of Mississippi River boats.
A farmer must choose between his land and his son.
A disabled gunfighter uses his son to exact revenge.
Josh believes a female killer is innocent.
Josh knows a supposed murder victim is alive.
A gambler (George Peppard) and a former U.S. marshal help a woman (Jean Simmons) save her stagecoach business from a town boss (Dean Martin).
Betrayed by his best friend (John Savage), a cowboy (Bill Pullman) must protect his herd from rustlers and risk losing his fiancée (Diane Lane).
A bank teller and a female doctor find themselves caught up in robbery and murder.
A dishonored Army officer pursues a missing major for the government.
A lawman and a bounty hunter hold the fates of a young outlaw and his fiancée in their hands.
A brave man's reputation suffers under torture.
Love for her son blinds a frontier mother.
A sheriff has a reputation for extracting confessions from the accused.
A man risks his life to save his nephew from error.
A lonely woman shelters a wounded fugitive against her husband's wishes.
A man single-handedly runs a frontier town.
A peace treaty is delivered to an Indian chief by black cavalrymen.
Cisco catches two men who illegally want $10,000 from a local bank.
A lawman's (Robert Taylor) former outlaw partner (Richard Widmark) forces him at gunpoint to lead the way to their buried loot.
Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

Bill is serving as Marshall of Rio Nada, an area plagued by Mexican bandits who cross the border to raid the countryside; he captures one of the bandits and threatens him with hanging to get the identity of the bandit leader.
